language_policy.required_cell_equivalence_clarification: Cases in the same required authoring cell may necessarily test the same abstract capability across languages, especially S4_UNDO. They must still be conceived independently and use natural, non-literal, non-template-equivalent wording. This permitted semantic equivalence is not permission for parallel translations.
language_policy.claim_limit: The design balances language tags; it does not by itself prove per-language accuracy.

known_families: locate, list, read, create, update, move, share, compress or delete digital files, folders and images
find, read, send, reply to, move or delete messages
find, read, update or delete contacts and persons
find, read, create, update or delete events, calendars and tasks
find, read, create, update or delete issues and pull requests
find or get URLs, places, location, current time, packages, processes, credentials and signatures
filter, sort, group, describe or compute over supplied entries, text, numbers and files
manage a login session, skills and credentials
request approval and undo the immediately preceding turn
clearly_outside_examples_for_category_de: physical-world actions with no registered digital capability
controlling an unregistered appliance or vehicle
booking or ordering through an unregistered external service
capability_overview_for_natural_authorin.instruction: Use these only as broad capability families. Do not mention registry identifiers and do not copy the example wording.

cells_per_language.instruction: Six distinct, ordinary single-intent digital requests from different known capability families. Vary directness, morphology and argument completeness naturally.
Three requests with two or more indispensable known digital actions that are independent; neither consumes the result of the other.
Three requests with a natural producer-to-consumer dependency between known digital actions.
Four compound requests mixing a known digital action with one indispensable clearly outside capability, plus two outside-only but understandable requests. Do not make them absurd or unsafe.
Six naturally varied requests: indirect, elliptical, polite, colloquial, long-distance dependency or multiple clauses. Preserve a decipherable intent; do not make all ambiguous.
Two requests involving consequential digital changes where approval ownership and the approved body matter.
Two requests where a tempting action is explicitly negated while another action remains requested.
One conditional request where actions belong to different branches and have an explicit order. Keep the condition understandable.
One natural request to undo the immediately preceding assistant turn, without adding another operation.
One request that indispensably combines undo of the immediately preceding turn with a separate digital operation. Both clauses must remain explicit and neither may be silently dropped.
One understandable request whose indispensable capability is clearly outside the known families and must not be approximated by a digital action.

quality_rules: No two queries may be literal translations or close syntactic paraphrases across languages. Abstract semantic equivalence forced by a required authoring cell is allowed only when wording is independently conceived and natural for that language.
Use diverse entities, domains, tones and syntactic structures.
Do not quote or imitate benchmark-like wording.
Do not include explanations, labels, answers or intended operations in query text.
Do not include personally identifying real-world data, secrets, harmful instructions or illegal content.
Do not resolve semantic uncertainty by inventing a new capability or policy; report the issue instead.
The proposal must be deterministic UTF-8 JSON with cases ordered by language roster then cell order, and IDs sequential from h4-0001 to h4-0320.
